# PR risk rules. One path pattern per line, relative to the repository root.
#   **  matches any number of directories, e.g. **/auth/** matches an auth directory anywhere
#   *   matches any characters within one directory level, e.g. docs/*.md
# Tiers: any changed file matching [high] → high; every changed file matching [low] → low; anything else → medium.
# Two kinds of PRs ignore paths: merging a release/* branch → high (merging is releasing, so you confirm it);
# merging back from main or master → low (the content was already reviewed on main).
# Low-risk PRs can merge once CI and the AI review pass; medium and high risk need you to review the change and add the human-reviewed label.
# High-risk PRs get a deeper AI review.
# The rules are read from the target branch, so a PR that changes this file does not change its own tier.

[high]
# The workflow and standards themselves: relaxing checks, changing baselines or changing CI always needs a human
